# More needs more renewers

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`more-needs-renewers` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](more-needs-renewers.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> More generation needs more renewers: generation more without end needs replenishment with no eventual bound and, with bounded capacity, renewers with no eventual bound; under a census of active formations it implies unceasing generation.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Reading conditions as amounts: a flow gives the formations taking part in each step and how much each takes from and gives to each condition; it balances a web of dependence when every change of a condition's level is what is taken and given. (`Becoming.Flow`, `Becoming.Flow.taken`, `Becoming.Flow.given`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances`)
2. For a finite family of conditions, the total after a step plus its uptake equals the total before plus its replenishment, and the same holds over any stretch of steps (the balance of depletion and replenishment). (`Becoming.Web.stock`, `Becoming.Flow.uptake`, `Becoming.Flow.replenishment`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.over`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.accumulates`)
3. When the flow balances and only active formations give, every rise is made by some active renewer, so the correspondence premise RenewedBy of unceasing-generation-needs-renewal becomes a theorem. (`Becoming.Flow.Acting`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.renewedBy`, `Becoming.Web.RenewedBy`)
4. Generation is more without end when, for every number, from some step on at least that many formations take from the family at every step. Amounts are natural numbers, so each taker takes at least one unit per step; over any stretch from which at least K formations take, the family is replenished by at least K per step, less its stock at the start, and more without end needs replenishment with no eventual bound. Over any amounts the same holds with a least take in Archimedean amounts, of which this is the whole-number instance; with takes that halve it fails (least-loss-rest). (`Becoming.Flow.takers`, `Becoming.Flow.More`, `Becoming.Flow.takers_le_uptake`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.replenished_over`, `Becoming.Flow.More.replenishment_unbounded`)
5. When each formation gives the family at most a fixed amount per step, the number of renewers grows in the same averaged sense and has no eventual bound, but it can be zero at infinitely many steps. (`Becoming.Flow.Capacity`, `Becoming.Flow.renewers`, `Becoming.Flow.replenishment_le`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.renewers_over`, `Becoming.Flow.More.renewers_unbounded`, `Becoming.Pulse.pulsed`)
6. Under a census of active formations (the active formations at each step listed once in a finite list), if the flow's present lists each formation once per step and only active formations take (only this half of Taking is used), the active formations grow without bound and more without end implies unceasing generation. (`Becoming.Web.Census`, `Becoming.Flow.Taking`, `Becoming.Web.arises_of_more`, `Becoming.Web.unceasing_of_growth`, `Becoming.Flow.More.grows`, `Becoming.Flow.More.unceasing`)
7. The expansion and the cycle meet all these premises, so the implication is not vacuous; the oscillator that arises again and again meets these premises and is not more, so the implication is strict; without a census, with a formation listed many times in present, or with takers that are not active, more without end can come with nothing arising. (`Becoming.Expansion.counted`, `Becoming.Cycle.counted`, `Becoming.Oscillation.counted`, `Becoming.Oscillation.not_more`, `Becoming.Dormant.more_without_arising`, `Becoming.Repeated.more_without_arising`, `Becoming.Inactive.more_without_arising`)
8. A flow in which a renewer and a grower arise at every step meets every premise and is more without end; in a closed cycle each formation gives back what it takes, the total never changes, generation is more without end, and the renewers are exactly the takers. (`Becoming.Expansion.more`, `Becoming.Expansion.growers_take`, `Becoming.Cycle.closed_more`)
9. So in balanced flows the replenishment needed by recurring uptake and by more without end forms a strict hierarchy: the first, of which unceasing arising of takers is one case, needs replenishment at arbitrarily late steps, the second replenishment with no eventual bound. (`Becoming.Flow.More.replenishment_unbounded`, `Becoming.Oscillation.not_more`)
10. The balance, replenishment and renewer laws hold in every world with the local condition inside the law: balance only on the stretch used, or from the step used; the forms with balance everywhere are their corollaries. (`Becoming.Flow.accumulates_on`, `Becoming.Flow.replenished_over_on`, `Becoming.Flow.renewers_over_on`, `Becoming.Flow.More.replenishment_unbounded_from`, `Becoming.Flow.More.renewers_unbounded_from`)
11. More without end makes generation unceasing with no census, given only lists covering the active formations at arbitrarily late steps and, from some step on, each formation taking part listed once, whatever takes active, and activity decided; the census forms are its corollaries. (`Becoming.Flow.takers_le_covering`, `Becoming.Flow.More.grows_covering`, `Becoming.Flow.More.unceasing_covering`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The family of conditions is a finite list; the formations taking part in each step form a finite list; levels and amounts taken and given are natural numbers, so each taker takes at least one unit per step (a positive minimum uptake). Where uptake could become arbitrarily small, more takers would not need more replenishment (argued, not formalized).
- The flow balances the web: every change of a condition's level is what the formations taking part take and give. The flow records what is actually taken and given, and present lists each formation taking part once per step; these are correspondence premises.
- “More” is read as: for every number, from some step on at least that many formations take from the family at every step. This is the author's reading.
- Capacity (used only for the conclusions about renewers): each formation gives the family at most a fixed amount per step.
- Census and Taking (used only for “more implies unceasing”): the active formations at each step can be listed once in a finite list, and activity is decidable (a hypothesis of the theorem, not an axiom); only active formations take, and only from conditions they draw on; More.unceasing uses only the first half.
- That present has no repetition at each step is also a necessary premise (Repeated). The converse of Taking (every drawer takes in the flow) is an application duty.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Yields no “more is better” or any ranking.
- “More” reads only the number of takers and does not state diversity, complexity or possibility; it constrains only sustained more, not the number at isolated steps.
- “Ever more” holds only in the averaged sense, and renewers can be absent at infinitely many steps. Witness: `Becoming.Pulse.pulsed`.
- The converse of Taking (every drawer takes in the flow) is an application duty. Witness: `Becoming.Unrecorded.drawing_without_taking`.
- Unceasing rests on identity across steps (identity-across-steps): more forces it under each one-to-one reading, arising under each split-free continuation, and, with new formations read as budding, only that active formations have no bound.
- The renewers can be the takers; carrying the demand further along the unfolding, “no finite part bears it alone”, needs a dissipation premise (no-finite-part-bears-taking states it and proves the claim for taking in flows). Witness: `Becoming.Cycle.closed_more`.
- The generation component is not added to any reading of living.
- The witnesses are minimal.
- **Counterexample:** Unceasing generation does not imply more (Oscillation.not_more): the oscillator arises again and again, the flow balances, and at most one formation takes; it meets the census, present without repetition and Taking (Oscillation.counted), so “more implies unceasing” is strict. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Flow.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Without a census, more without end does not imply unceasing generation (Dormant.more_without_arising): with every formation of the expansion's flow active from the start, every premise and Taking hold and generation is more without end, while nothing arises. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Population.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Without Taking, more without end does not imply unceasing generation (Inactive.more_without_arising): one active formation replenishes ever more takers that are never active, the census and present without repetition hold, and nothing arises; More counts takers in the flow, not living or dependent formations. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Population.lean)
- **Counterexample:** With repetition in present, more without end does not imply unceasing generation (Repeated.more_without_arising): one formation, always active, is listed t times at step t; the census, balance, Acting and Taking hold and generation is more without end, while nothing arises; only present without repetition fails. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Population.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The converse of Taking can fail (Unrecorded.drawing_without_taking): ever more formations are active, depend and draw, while the flow records no taking and more without end fails. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Population.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Renewers with no eventual bound are not ever more renewers at every step (Pulse.pulsed): each formation gives at most one unit and generation is more without end, while at every odd step no formation gives and nothing replenishes; “ever more” holds only in the averaged sense (Balances.renewers_over). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Flow.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The renewers can be the takers (Cycle.closed_more): each formation gives back what it takes, the family's total never changes, generation is unceasing and more without end, and the renewers are exactly the takers; without a dissipation premise the demand need not pass beyond the family. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Flow.lean)
- **Counterexample:** An independent review: every declaration under review is accepted with empty axiom reports; “strict hierarchy” failed as an implication, More counts takers, the minimum uptake was unstated, “ever more givers” and “no finite part bears it alone” were stronger than the theorems, and the ledger vocabulary conflicted with Ren's corrections (corrected in the integration note). [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/BECOMING-P9B-P10-P11-REVIEW.md)
- **Counterexample:** An independent review: every declaration under review is accepted with empty axiom reports; the chapter omitted the necessary premise that present has no repetition, the core had no positive witness meeting every premise, only half of Taking is used, the rename to renewer was incomplete, and the unceasing conclusion depends on one-to-one identity (corrected in the integration note). [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/BECOMING-P11B-P12-REVIEW.md)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing.

<a id="next--下一步"></a>
## Next

State other readings of “more”: rising possibility, diversity and complexity, and their relation to finite conditions and flows; a version with rational amounts and a floor on uptake; “more” under the one-kind reading; whether a generation component can enter a reading of living without repeating what the “no harm” readings give up.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren's words are “生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向” (a whole direction of unceasingly creating more 生). unceasing-generation-needs-renewal formalizes “unceasingly … 生”; this result formalizes one reading of “more”: more formations taking from the same conditions. Under Taking the takers are active formations that draw; whether “living” is read as some reading of living is not chosen. Rising possibility, diversity and complexity are other readings and are not stated here. The author reads the result as one structure of 生生: renewers are formations within the unfolding, so under Capacity more taking needs renewing formations whose number has no eventual bound and grows in an averaged sense (an AI argument; whether they arise is not stated); this neither replaces Ren's words nor shows that it is good. In Web and Flow formations and conditions are two kinds, so life as a condition of life (a formation as a condition of another) can be represented only through a proxy condition; life-as-condition-of-life reads it with one kind of relatum, proving that an embodied life arises only as another active formation gives to it. The new names are the reviewer's suggestions, adopted under Ren's naming rule (DELEGATED-CHOICES D36).
